title: Kudos now handles the rest
summary: A launch advert for Kudos 3.0, the app that negotiates bills, cancels forgotten subscriptions and switches on hidden card offers.
noticed: Every Kudos reel opens on a specific dollar amount, but almost none of them show the product itself moving.
built: An advert that opens the way their reels do, with four credits from their own posts, then shows the app doing the work and ends on their Your wins card. Every line and figure is theirs.

title: Discover. Book. Vote. Host.
summary: A 30-second advert for Tixby, the app for finding events, booking tickets, voting in competitions and hosting your own.
built: Four beats, one for each thing the app does: find an event, book in seconds, vote without signing in, and sell tickets as a host. Each beat gets its own colour and its own piece of the interface, and the piece closes on the four-word line.

title: The business school where you build real businesses
summary: A launch-week advert for Mesa School of Business in Bangalore, made the day after it announced a ₹110 crore raise.
noticed: Mesa's site is full of hard numbers, from ₹1 lakh in sales in your first four weeks to 58% of graduates in founder-facing roles, but none of them move.
built: An advert that opens on their own sales challenge filling up week by week, turns on their homepage headline, then walks through AI products, the Startup Lab and outcomes. Every line and figure is theirs, in their greens, lime and Manrope.

title: Our specialists know women's health. Period.
summary: A launch-week advert for Allara, the insurance-covered virtual care team for women's hormonal and metabolic health, made two days after it announced a $30M raise.
noticed: Allara's Instagram opens posts with a small italic question and a serif line with one word in italic, but nearly all of its video is filmed, and the numbers on its homepage never move.
built: An advert that opens the way their posts do, joins up the symptoms from their homepage, then shows the care team, the 50 states and their 98% and 90% figures. Every line and figure is theirs, in their navy, pale blue and pink.

title: See what drove revenue. Know what to run next.
summary: A launch-week advert for Marklo, the AI marketing calendar and campaign planner for Shopify brands, made four days after it announced a $5M seed round.
noticed: Marklo's Instagram is founder-led talking-head reels with burned-in captions, and its best lines, like "Every Q4 planning call sounds the same", never get to move.
built: An advert that opens on that Q4 planning call, throws the scattered tabs around the frame, then draws the Marklo wordmark and walks through the calendar, Ask Marklo and their month-in-a-day customer story. Every line and figure is theirs, in their espresso brown and pastel panels.

title: No fuel wahala. Just swap and go.
summary: An advert for MAX, the Lagos company putting commercial riders on electric motorbikes with battery swapping, made a week after its Series B3 round reached $29M.
noticed: MAX's Instagram is full of sharp money lines, like ₦1,395 per litre and ₦2,000 for 5–6 hours of riding, but they sit on stock footage and still cards, and the battery swap itself is never shown moving.
built: An advert that opens on their fuel-price post, stacks up the costs from their own reel, then rides an electric bike through the frame and animates the battery swap and the business savings. Every line and figure is theirs, read by a Nigerian voice over an Afrobeats percussion bed, in their yellow, green and chunky sticker type.
